label: run126 cod-reconcile (PROBE)
definition: run125 config EXACTLY (storage-as-commitment on, CT deployment OFF, ORDC overlay OFF) + the reconciled COD ramp. Collapses the two overlapping commercial-operation-date implementations (year-granular cod_ramp_enabled with ramp_bins/ramp_fleet, and the month-granular thermal_vintage_ramp that missed the ERCOT bins) into ONE month-precise mechanism: a single online mask in generators_to_fleet_arrays, sourced from the EIA-860 operable plant-code map (Operating Month/Year, capacity-weighted), covering every fleet path incl. the CAMPD bins, with retirement handling. Only the COD code differs from run125 (verified identical scenario_config). Effect is concentrated in 2023 (the most phantom-heavy year): ST_GAS over-run +10.5->+4.8, COAL_PRB +3.0->+0.6, COAL_LIGNITE +6.5->+5.8 all improve toward zero, while CC_REGULAR -0.9->-2.7 and CT_PEAKER -31.9->-39.8 under-runs deepen as the month mask removes mid-2023-COD CC/ST capacity (e.g. Brotman 484 MW from May, Remy Jade 484 MW dropped). 2024/2025 ~unchanged. Operating-shape gate PASSES all classes. run125 stays the KEEPER until this gated change is reviewed.
